title: invalid accountId returns notFound; RFC 8620 requires accountNotFound
description: kith-chat/src/chat.rs:44,152,388,521 (and same pattern in kith-chat/src/contact.rs, message.rs) — when accountId != 'a-self', handlers return JmapError::not_found() (error_type: 'notFound'). RFC 8620 §5.1 specifies the error type must be 'accountNotFound' for an unrecognized account. The distinction matters: JMAP clients specifically check for 'accountNotFound' to trigger re-authentication. Also missing: JmapError::account_not_found() constructor in kith-core/src/error.rs.
